blocks.text: Bold faith steps out on nothing but the word of God, the promises of God.
Step out by faith and it shall be done. God said, "let there be light: and there was light" (Genesis 1: 3).
Miracles are for those who boldly step out by the word of God. Jesus, as God, by foreknowledge knows everything,

Boldly step out by faith on the promises of God. Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever" (Hebrews 13: 8). "Yesterday" here means that the miracles in the Old Testament are possible to us. If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed; In a little grain of faith, there are millions of miracles.
Bold faith can withstand anything. With bold faith, you are dealing with the supernatural.

Jesus stepped out on the word of God. He spoke to the dead and they rose up (Matthew 9: 23-25). He stopped a funeral procession (Luke 7: 12-15). The elements obeyed Him. He spoke to bread and it increased. He spoke to a tree and it withered. He spoke to a fish and it brought forth a coin.
Your case is not unusual. He healed the insane. Boldly, Jesus faced legion and cast out all the demons.
We have a great God. The works that I do shall you do and greater works shall you do (John 14: 12). Also, "…these signs shall follow them that believe…" (Mark 16: 17).
Expect the greatest. Boldly step out on nothing but the word of God. Believe that when you speak, it shall take place.
Jesus loves faith. The whole gospel is based on forgiveness and faith. It is impossible to please the Lord without faith (Hebrews 11: 6).
Nothing in this world can buy the faith that can heal the sick.
Believe for greater works. Miracles are real.
Be careful. Do not think that the Lord is against you just because you have problems. It is the devil that is against you. The Lord will draw you to himself.
Let your motor begin to run in faith and you will see what will happen. No matter what your situation is, have faith in Jesus Christ. There is reward for diligence and determined faith.
We are just passing through this world. It is only the beginning. It is nothing compared to the eternity that the Lord has prepared for those that love Him. Amen.
